id./param/talk_party/talk_party_a060.pack|t: Hey, {var:1}. Weren't we going to take those two lost kids to the bar?
I get why that Veronica brat is annoying, but we can't ignore little Connie.
They're probably both waiting for you in Hotto, so let's hurry back.
So the little one, Veronica, is the big sister, and grown-up Serena is the younger? I'll mix them up for a while.
A little sister bigger than her big sister... I wonder how that feels for them. Hard to imagine.
At this rate, sister's magic might be abused by the monsters. Please hurry to the underground labyrinth west of Hotto.
...Still, little sister is rather adorable too. What is this bittersweet feeling...
Hey, where are you going, {var:1}? Aren't we looking for a way to Yggdrasil?
That shady guy locked up in the wasteland labyrinth, Noah... He was a famous informant, I think.
He might know something about the Great Tree. Let's go to the bar in Hotto.
...Hey, {var:1}. Your family and friends often say you're spacey, don't they?
Serena's been like you since childhood, wandering off without listening. You two might get along.
Oh, {var:1}, out for a stroll? I love a slow walk too, but take care not to anger sister.
I'm always getting scolded by sister as slow or clumsy. Hee hee, a bit embarrassing.
We got caught in all kinds of accidents, but my magic is back and I got youth too. All's well that ends well.
Plus, beating bad monsters feels good. ...Though the people of Hotto were so carefree they never noticed them.
I stopped by Gallopolis briefly before meeting you, {var:1}. It had more people than Hotto and was fun.
When we reach Gallopolis safely, please take a breather. You must have been through a lot...
Things turned strange, but we're being chased too. Staying with Connie could endanger her.
Let's reunite Connie with her sister quick. She must be the girl in the red hood in front of the bar.
Thank you, big brother... Connie waited at the inn so long, it was so lonely.
Ugh... big brother. Please, don't leave Connie all alone...
Geez... Connie's fine, but I got involved with an annoying one. No time to babysit a brat.
Once we leave them with the bartender, let's slip away quick. We're being chased, after all.
A girl looking for her daddy, and how did you mishear it to get this mix-up?
Leaving it to you two gets us nowhere. The bartender surely knows something, so let's go to the bar.
Connie's daddy is flighty. He's always leaving Connie and wandering off...
Daddy... where did you go? Connie can't even stay at an inn alone...
I don't like Veronica, but her sister Serena did nothing wrong. Let's go rescue her quick.
Veronica's sister must be a really little girl, right? We can't leave her in a monster nest.
I travel with Serena. We stopped at Hotto, heard the steam bath was good for the skin, and rested our feet.
I never thought I'd be kidnapped by monsters in the steam bath. What dangerous times.
The monsters' hideout should be in the underground labyrinth west of Hotto. Let's go when you're ready.
The monsters' hideout should be in the underground labyrinth west of Hotto. Let's go when you're ready.
Oh, {var:1}, forgot something? The monster that took my magic is tough, so don't underestimate it.
When we first reached this village, we were so thrilled to find a bath that we rested here a while.
Hee hee. After we recover sister's magic, I'd like one last steam bath here.
...Oh, {var:1}? Sister seemed to be asking something, or did I imagine it?
If you forgot, be careful. When sister gets truly angry, a strong Frizz comes flying...
That shady guy locked up in the wasteland labyrinth, Noah... He was a famous informant, I think.
He might know something about the Great Tree. Let's go to the bar for now.
The evil god was defeated, so why was the Luminary born into this world? We don't know either.
So to find the truth, we were chosen as envoys to lead you to Yggdrasil, closely tied to the Luminary.
Even we don't know how to reach Yggdrasil.
First, let's trust Erik's words and visit the informant, Noah.
A branch of the Great Tree glittering in seven colors... Sounds fishy, but we've got nothing else to bet on.
Then let's go to Gallopolis in the southwest, where the Great Tree's branch is said to be.
I thought Erik was a hopeless one at first, but he's useful sometimes.
Still, who plucked that branch from Yggdrasil? What a sacrilegious person.
But if we meet whoever plucked it, we might learn how to reach Yggdrasil. Exciting!
We may be mismatched, clumsy twin sisters, but please take care of us from now on.
The Luminary chosen by Yggdrasil, {var:1}, and his friend Erik... Hee hee, it will be a fun journey.
We've ended up somewhere confusing. Hey, {var:1}, are you lost?
Ah, now I'm losing my way too. If you're unsure where you are, check the map often. Highly recommended.
This labyrinth feels nasty. It smells like many people have died here...
Let's find that Serena girl quick and get out of here. My thief's instincts say so.
{var:1}, be careful. Traps are set everywhere here. Get past them wrong and you can't get out.
When I escaped, I nearly got truly lost. Watch the floor especially.
Hmm... Being Veronica's sister, I figured we'd have two cheeky, graceless brats...
Serena's gentle and honest. My expectations were broken, in a good way. I'm getting motivated.
Serena and I were always the same height since birth, so standing like this feels strange.
But being this size let me escape when locked up. Lucky those monsters were so dim.
Let's go, {var:1}. The monster that took my magic should be at the deepest part of the wasteland labyrinth.
I wondered what would happen, but I'm relieved sister is safe.
Sister's childlike look will surely return to normal once we retrieve her stolen magic.
Let us go. ...{var:1}.
Arboria's clan, protectors of the Luminary... As I guessed, you really are the Luminary who'll save the world.
And a Dark One... Meeting Veronica and Serena may really be fate.
My magic is back safely, but there's one more person I want to save.
There should be another room beyond where we beat Jarvis. Help me find it.
It's a pity sister's form didn't return, but spending time again with my cute little sister feels like a bonus.
...{var:1}. From now on, together with sister, we will protect you with our lives.
What is it, {var:1}? That informant Noah said he'd go back to Hotto, remember?
Coming back here now, I doubt anyone besides Noah was caught by Jarvis.
What business do you have here now? It isn't a good-memory place for me, so I want to leave.
Could it be you can't leave missed treasure chests alone, {var:1}? Well... I get it.
...This place looks familiar. Isn't this where sister was held?
Hee hee. Caves and towers draw me in even with no reason. I think the Luminary and I share a hobby.
What is it, {var:1}? Did you come to check that Jarvis and his shadows were really beaten?
If it bugs you, I'll go anywhere with you... but don't detour too much.
The worst thing about the cells in Heliodor Castle? The food was terrible.
I ate nothing but hard bread, and nearly chipped a tooth. I never want to go back there.
Sigh... I only meant to enjoy the steam bath and got into a mess. Shouldn't have looked after the brat.
Once we deliver those two to the bar in Hotto, let's slip away quick. We're being chased, after all.
Are you lost, {var:1}? If you don't know where to go, check the map often.
I got lost often too, right after leaving on my trip with Serena. Keep opening the map for a while.
Hey, {var:1}. Saving Serena is fine, but we still have things to do, remember?
If you detour too much, Veronica will give you an earful. Let's get her magic back quick.
Hey, {var:1}. Were you listening to us? Aren't you forgetting something important?
Thanks to someone's detours, my magic is bone dry. Sigh... when will it return?
...Oh, {var:1}? While I was spacing out, we came somewhere unfamiliar.
At this rate, sister's magic may be abused by monsters. Please hurry to the underground labyrinth west of Hotto.
Go to Yggdrasil in the sky and we'll learn why the Luminary was born, right? Wild, but we'll have to believe it.
...Still, it's hot here. Let's get that branch at Gallopolis Castle and get out of this heat.
According to informant Noah, a seven-colored branch of Yggdrasil is in Gallopolis Castle, right?
Whether the branch gets us to the tree is unknown, but we have no other lead. Let's go to Gallopolis.
I visited Gallopolis, which rules this desert, before meeting you, {var:1}. It's a lovely kingdom.
Back then I found no way to reach Yggdrasil, but let's trust Noah's words and go.
Going to the castle to ask about the branch can wait until after we look around town!
{var:1}! Since we've got the chance, let's see the sights! We might hear about the branch too!
I came to this kingdom before to look for you, {var:1}. It's livelier than before, I was surprised.
To reach the castle, climb the central stairs and circle around the paddock's second floor.
{var:1}, it's a very big kingdom, so let's be careful not to get lost.
Oh, what a lovely castle... As expected of Gallopolis, famed as a great power of Erdrea.
Now, let's ask the Sultan about the branch that might be tied to Yggdrasil. We may learn something.
Huh, so this is the racetrack. Even outsiders like us seem able to enter the horse race.
...But our goal is the branch. Go easy on horse racing and let's get to the Sultan soon.
